title: Live Updates: Pilot May Have Attempted to Crash Flight to Israel, Netanyahu Says
summary_full: Passengers intervened and “prevented a disaster” after one pilot stabbed another during a flight from Dubai, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said. The plane landed safely in Saudi Arabia. The motive for the attack was not clear.
